about: Who holds which part of the battery RAM stock leaves free (0x100f859c-0x100fff00): it keeps its contents through a power cycle. Ranges are [from, to). sdk/tests/test_battery_ram.py checks that no two overlap, and that every address the base, a module or a draft names in that span lies in a range here: the base's in any range (it reads the others' records), a module's or draft's in one its owner (the folder's name) holds. The base's per-module store is planned, not built (docs/OCTATRACK_API.md, Keeping state); a range here is how a module keeps settings through a power cycle until then.

ranges.what: 'PMNV': each pattern's play mode, 256 rows of 9 bytes and a 16-bit sum
the draft's magic long and its 2048-byte table
fxmap.c's map of module effect handles
diag.c's trace of the frames before a stall
